note: v501: Audit pass over the Time Clock and the Budget. Time logged in the evening was filed under the NEXT day by the Time Log's From/To filter — so filtering a day could hide work the app had just listed under it, and leave those hours out of the total and off an invoice built from that view. And when a payday lands on a weekend you're paid the Friday before, which can fall in the previous month: reconciling that month offered no payday to record the deposit under, so it stayed unexplained and the month never passed. Both fixed.
